messages:
maria: dropped a new mock for the trace drilldown header — focusing on affordances (download vs kebab), frame label wording, and the truncated correlation ID UX. quick question: do we expose a tiny download icon in the header or keep export only in the kebab? figma: https://figma.com/s/trace-drilldown-ux

*tariq:* i'm leaning icon + kebab redundancy. support folks want one-click during incidents, but we shouldn't make it a heavy primary. icon-only with a good aria-label + focus ring seems ideal.

*sam:* agree with @tariq. tiny icon for power users, kebab for discoverability. if icon's visible, make sure tab order doesn't put it before the correlation pill — users often copy the CID first. current order is: CID -> export -> more; i'd prefer CID -> more -> export.

*katie:* copy notes: "Stack snippet" is ambiguous. propose "Top frames (filtered)" or "Relevant stack frames" depending on audience. also under CID: "Click to copy full correlation ID" — we truncate visually so that helps.

*maria:* good call. for the icon aria-label i'm thinking: "Download trace & attachments". tooltip copy could be "Download trace and any attached files (zip)". keeps expectations clear.

*tariq:* implementation nit: please use a real <button>, not a div, and include `aria-label` + `aria-describedby` that points to the helper text for SR users. add visible focus style. avoid title attr as the only accessible label.

*sam:* a11y flow: when drilldown opens, focus should move to the drilldown heading. otherwise screen reader users stay on the list and miss context. also announce 'Trace details for <RequestID>' if possible.

*katie:* contrast check: helper microcopy under the CID is currently 50% gray — run it against 4.5:1. if it fails, darken or bump size.

*maria:* proposal to decide on:
- show small download icon left of kebab (icon-only, not primary)
- keep export in kebab too for discoverability
- aria-label: "Download trace & attachments"
- frame label: "Relevant stack frames"
- helper text: "Click to copy full correlation ID"
- when drilldown opens, focus moves to heading and SR announces context
- keep keyboard order: CID -> more -> download

*tariq:* acceptance criteria:
- icon reachable by tab and activatable via Enter/Space
- screen reader reads heading and helper text on open
- icon has visible focus ring and an `aria-label` that reads as intended
- helper contrast >= 4.5:1

*design-bot:* accessibility checklist: keyboard nav, focus management, aria-labels present, tooltip accessible, contrast verification. missing: documented keyboard shortcut if we add one.

*maria:* i'll update figma and prototype keyboard tab stops. can someone run a quick SR pass after i push?

*katie:* i'll run VoiceOver on mac and leave notes.

*sam:* i'll run NVDA + keyboard flow and post results.

*maria:* thanks all. leaving open until prototype. please react if you're ok with the plan. :thumbsup:

*katie:* :thumbsup:
